RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Runecarver
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Deal actual chain damage to 60 secondary targets

descriptions.li: Adds 3 additional chain levels.
Every third valid hit deals 90 additional lightning damage to the original target.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Sunfire core
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Deal 2,000 actual burn damage while worn

descriptions.li: Adds 4 burn levels and 3 Sunfire aura levels.
Killing a standing enemy deals 90 blast damage to up to 16 standing enemies within 6 tiles. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Secondary kills cannot trigger further blasts.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Bloodforged armor
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Generate 1,200 direct-attack lifesteal healing while worn, including excess

descriptions.li: Adds 50% direct lifesteal. Converts 50% of the wearer's excess healing into a shield on the recipient for 10 seconds, capped at 400 × health bonus multiplier.
Stores three times the direct damage taken from enemies as vengeance damage. It is consumed by the next direct attack against an enemy.
Adds 3 steel marks to each steel proc and 200% health.
Each direct attack against an enemy deals additional damage equal to 15 × the wearer's actual health scale.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Frozen heart
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Successfully stun enemies 30 times while worn

descriptions.li: About every 4.2 seconds, slows the nearest 12 enemies within 6 tiles. About every 8.3 seconds, gains 40 shield points per nearby enemy, lasting 10 seconds.
Successfully stunning an enemy deals 120 additional damage to it. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Hydra's embrace
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Deal actual cleave damage to 80 secondary targets while worn

descriptions.li: Adds 4 cleave levels and 100% damage.
Killing a standing enemy heals 80 injury points and grants 100% movement speed and 100% damage for 10 seconds. Further kills refresh the duration.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Siege crossbow
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Hit enemies at least 12 cells away 60 times while worn

descriptions.li: Adds 10 tiles of range and 20% additional damage per tile beyond 4 tiles, counting at most 25 tiles.
Valid hits extend a straight path 12 tiles behind the original target, about 2.5 tiles wide. Standing enemies in the path take 50% of this hit's direct damage.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Soul vessel
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: While worn, earn 40 contribution shares from eligible enemy defeats

descriptions.li: Grants 4 additional permanent soul marks per full contribution share.
New active ability: consume 10–50 soul marks to deal 30 damage per mark to up to 16 standing enemies within 16 tiles. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Moonlight loom
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Actually heal 1,200 injury points on the wearer or allies while worn

descriptions.li: Adds 3 group-healing levels. Converts 50% of the wearer's excess healing into a shield on the recipient for 10 seconds, capped at 400 × health bonus multiplier.
After healing actual injuries, deals 200% of that healing as damage to the nearest enemy within 12 tiles. Cooldown: 1 second.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Gambler's coin
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Earn 5,000 silver from base bounties while worn

descriptions.li: Adds 200 silver to the base bounty per kill and 50% critical value.
Killing a standing enemy grants 250 shield points for 10 seconds.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Universal forge
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Spend 2 days working while worn, including travel to jobs

descriptions.li: Adds 300% work speed and 100% mining yield.
While drafted, grants 160 shield points to the nearest 12 allied human colonists within 8 tiles about every 8.3 seconds. Shields last 10 seconds.

RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.label: Dragonheart
RimHex.HexAwakeningDef.description: Wear for a total of 3 days, including caravans

descriptions.li: Each dragon soul grants another 60% health and 60% damage, up to an additional 360% of each.
Adds 6 injury points healed per second. About every 4.2 seconds, heals 30 injury points on each of the nearest 12 allied human colonists within 10 tiles.
